[marginalia]
[del]If[/del] [ins]By[/ins] [del]x[/del] [ins]y[/ins], [del](10m+1)(10n+1)=10^p+1[/del]
= 100mn+10(m+n)+1
Then
100mn+10(m+n) = 10^p-10
and
10mn+m+n = 10^{p-1}-1
and since p=2
10mn+m+n = 9
when (10^2m+1)(10^2n+1)=(10^2p+1)(10^2q+1)
p=1=q
10^2mn+m+n = (10^2-1)(10^2+1)
[/marginalia]
